get.summary: Check whether profile completion can be skipped (NiceMatrix carrier sign-up)
get.description: NiceMatrix extension. Returns whether the current interaction is a carrier one-tap sign-up whose user has not been created yet, i.e. whether the remaining sign-up requirements may be skipped.

200.description: `skippable` is true only for a `Register` interaction whose verified social identity is the carrier connector.

post.description: NiceMatrix extension. Records the user's choice to skip the remaining sign-up requirements (secondary identifiers, password, custom profile fields) for the current carrier one-tap sign-up. Call identification and submit afterwards, as after a completed profile form.

204.description: The skip has been recorded on the current interaction.

400.description: The current interaction is not a carrier sign-up awaiting profile completion.
